Definition: {(only in the dual) a pair of scales}
BiblicalUsage: Mozen is a pair of scales — the balances in which Belshazzar is weighed on the night Babylon falls: 'Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.'
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God still weighs kings and kingdoms, and the scales do not lie.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
